title: Microtutorial GIF strip for key rotation, streaming and toolcall onboarding
creator: Ava Morales
description: Create a compact, accessible microtutorial GIF strip (3–5 frames per flow) that demonstrates: 1) API key creation and safe rotation, 2) starting a streaming response (client-side token handling + reconnect), and 3) invoking a toolcall (tool registration -> JSON result flow). Deliverables: optimized GIFs for web docs, single-frame fallback PNG snapshots, a sprite-sheet for the docs static site, and a short Lottie fallback for mobile. The assets should be modular so they can be embedded in the SDK quickstart pages, onboarding email, and the Console 'First Run' modal. Include responsive export sizes (desktop 1200x560, tablet 900x420, mobile 420x300) and a dev-friendly sprite map (2x and 3x variants).
acceptance_criteria: Each GIF has an accessible text transcript and a single-frame PNG fallback
Figma source file with named frames + export presets checked into docs-assets (Figma link in attachments)
Exported GIFs optimized under 350KB for mobile, desktop under 600KB; sprite-sheet with accompanying JSON map
Design signoff from PM (Liam Chen) and engineering review passed for integrated snippets (PR referenced)
All code snippets shown in GIF match the latest SDK quickstart copy in docs-2026.03
